description: An oil painting of a dim, peeling-plaster tenement stairwell with an iron banister. Around nine people, mostly older and working-class adults in dark coats and jackets, stand on the stone stairs with arms folded and stern faces, a headscarved older woman on the left and a young man in the centre. At the bottom right, a man seen from behind in a dark overcoat and glasses holds a clipboard with a document, facing them. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
